## SHADOW VARIANT — parallel-run test against Relay.app

Exercises the FULL classify/extract/calendar/conflict LLM logic of prod [R2b], but writes ONLY to a test Slack channel. It NEVER posts a Missive comment and NEVER mutates a real conversation (no label-remove, no team-move).

**FILL-IN PLACEHOLDER (replace before activating):**
- `C0BJKK8V0VB` → real Slack channel id for a test channel (both Slack nodes)

**PARALLEL-RUN SETUP:** the Missive webhook TRIGGER is unchanged. To run shadow alongside Relay, add a SECOND Missive rule with the SAME label condition pointing at THIS shadow webhook URL (path b2c9e4f1-...-avails2b0001). Do not remove the Relay rule.
